hotfix.issue: Grab could appear unresponsive or fail to complete the Basic Attacks checklist when the Sage stopped outside real grab range or remained briefly invulnerable/airborne after another lesson attack.
repairs: The Sage now approaches and begins the Basic Attacks lesson inside close grab range.
A Grab pressed within a forgiving teaching radius stabilizes the Sage and places him inside the real 74-unit grab range before the shared engine resolves it.
The checklist completes from a confirmed connected grab damage event, not only from a temporary animation flag.
Out-of-range attempts display MOVE CLOSER and explain that Grab is a close-range action.
The tutorial card shows live distance guidance until the grab succeeds.
